description.zh: 压强 p = F/S：同样的力，接触面积越小压强越大；液体内 p = ρgh；密闭液体中压强处处相等。适用于静止、不可压缩液体与理想接触面的教学模型。
description.en: Pressure p = F/S: the same force on a smaller area gives higher pressure; in a liquid p = ρgh; in a sealed liquid pressure is the same everywhere. A teaching model for still, incompressible liquids and ideal contact areas.

reason.zh: 液压机里 F₂ = F₁·S₂/S₁ 放大了力，但大活塞位移按同一比例缩小，理想情况下输入功等于输出功，这正是功与能量的账本。
reason.en: In a hydraulic press F₂ = F₁·S₂/S₁ multiplies force while the big piston’s travel shrinks by the same factor, so ideal input work equals output work — the work–energy ledger.

title.zh: 为什么小力能顶起大重物？
title.en: Why can a small force lift a big weight?

ask.zh: 同样的力，接触面积越小压强越大——针尖和手指按同一个图钉，哪个压强大？
ask.en: The same force on a smaller area means higher pressure — pressing one drawing pin, is the pressure bigger at the point or at the flat end?

ask.zh: 密闭液体中压强处处相等——小活塞上加小力，大活塞为什么能顶起大重物？能量从哪里来？
ask.en: Pressure is equal everywhere in a sealed liquid — why can a small force on a small piston lift a big weight on a big piston? Where does the energy come from?

reveal.zh: p = F/S，小面积上小力产生大压强，传到大面积上就是大力；小活塞移动距离长、大活塞移动距离短，能量仍守恒。
reveal.en: p = F/S: a small force on a small area makes a large pressure, which on a large area becomes a large force; the small piston travels far and the big one travels little, so energy is still conserved.
